texts: In the late summer of Year 1, one day before the autumn equinox, Bevin Coombe walked the Cove Stair at sundown.
Bevin Coombe touched the iron bands of the Stilllight Lantern.
Bevin Coombe lit the Stilllight Lantern.
The Stilllight Lantern burned mire-essence from dusk until dawn.
Bevin Coombe walked the Cove Stair again at midnight.
Bevin Coombe walked the Cove Stair again at the third watch.
Bevin Coombe refreshed the mire-essence of the Stilllight Lantern at midnight.
Bevin Coombe trimmed the wick of the Stilllight Lantern at the third watch.

q2_gaps: bare MASS-noun object in an episodic clause — "burned mire-essence from dusk until dawn" is a dated one-off, but the rule that mints an existential witness for a set taking part in an occurrence is written for a bare PLURAL object, and the bare-kind-filler contrast case ("grows wheat") is habitual; nothing decides specific-vs-kind for a bare mass in an episodic clause

a traversed path / route as direct object — "walked the Cove Stair" gives the stair neither a change of state (Patient) nor any of Theme's senses (acquired, transferred, moved, possessed, perceived, evaluated), and there is no Path role; Theme is reachable only through the "when the test is unclear, default to Theme" fallback

distributivity of a definite plural in a NON-subject role — "touched the iron bands" puts a group witness in Theme, but the per-member distribution rule is only ever stated for subject predicates (barked, passed, resigned), so whether an object group distributes is unaddressed
review.notes: The wick/lantern and iron-bands/lantern PartOf links are licensed here by the explicit "of"-genitive, so they do not fall foul of the Core-patterns example that bars an unstated wick-in-lantern part link; midnight / third_watch / late_summer as bare Time constants follow the day-part and first_quarter precedents. One consequence of the bare-kind choice in statement 4: "burned mire-essence" (kind filler mire_essence) and "the mire-essence of the Stilllight Lantern" (witness sk_mire_essence_1) share no symbol.
